name: server/mzizi-harness
title: mzizi-harness
summary: The Mzizi harness: one scoped log, motion and announce interface, the same for the UI, the language and every server component. Every server component plugs into it.

surface.summary: What a component needs from its host: event (log), motion, announce.
One thing that happened: a static name, a level, static-keyed fields.
A field value: a static string, an integer or a flag. Never a runtime string.
Reduced flag and enter and exit durations. STILL and STANDARD.
How urgently a screen reader reads an announcement.
The harness that does nothing; the default.
A shared harness, as a component holds it.

guarantees.statement: A harness handed to a component receives its events; the default harness ignores them.
A host with no screen has no motion and announces nothing: the defaults are Motion::STILL and a no-op announce.
A UI host can override motion and announce; the log path is the same.

harness.secrets: An Event's name and field keys are &'static str, and a string field value is a &'static str, so no connection string, password, collection name or document can be formatted into one. Only integers and flags vary. announce takes a runtime string because a live region reads prose; server components never call it.

gaps: No Rust UI component takes a Shared harness yet: the Roots UI crates take props such as prefers_reduced_motion, and adopting this trait there is a follow-up.

The TypeScript harness (useMziziHarness) and the Mzizi language's harness are separate implementations of the same three capabilities; this crate does not generate or share code with them, so their agreement is by contract, not by construction.
Only mzizi-mongodb plugs into it so far; mzizi-assurance, mzizi-fundi, mzizi-docs, mzizi-discovery and mzizi-activitypub do not yet.
